slices.summary: Adds keyset-paged ListThreads (cursor, by-id thread_id, archived filter) over a new threads.last_activity_at column with an owner-activity index, the BFF cursor endpoint and a by-id durable read, and the FE paged client, so threads past the 80-thread cap list, open and reload. Tags per the 4.3 final: cursor 8, thread_id 9, archived 10, next_cursor 2, archived_at 15.

slices.title: Gateway handles for remaining read tools
slices.summary: Parks oversized output of fetch_url, knowledge_search and web_search behind gateway handles that are readable by range (4,000 characters per read), and replays the stored screening verdict and trust label on every read. Parking is refused for external content whose screening was skipped, and never happens under ZDR.

slices.title: Catalogue the existing provider reads behind a golden
slices.summary: Adds the read operations that integration-corev2 already implements (mail.messages.get, drive.file.content, sharepoint sites and drives, profile, gmail.messages.get) to the execution-core catalogue with real parameter summaries, guarded by a vendored golden table with a pinned sha256 that Go and Rust both check, plus a Go CI workflow. Writes are not added. The frozen docs/actions-surface-operations.md gets a dated addendum after owner sign-off (K3-14) instead of staying untouched.
